channel.title: Flog It!
channel.desc: At the stunning gardens at Tatton Park in Cheshire and from Liverpool's historic docks, Paul Martin is joined by Mark Stacey, Anita Manning and David Fletcher. Anita is captivated by some Belle Epoque hatpins, and David is delighted when he gets to value a Bassett-Lowke train set, a childhood favourite. Meanwhile, Paul takes a closer look at the lost treasures of Liverpool.
